Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.

args.sql:
SELECT 
    p.page_name as product,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as views,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as added_to_cart,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 AND e.visit_id NOT IN (SELECT visit_id FROM bank_sales_trading.main.shopping_cart_events WHERE event_type = 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as abandoned,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 AND e.visit_id IN (SELECT visit_id FROM bank_sales_trading.main.shopping_cart_events WHERE event_type = 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as purchased
FROM bank_sales_trading.main.shopping_cart_events e
JOIN bank_sales_trading.main.shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
WHERE p.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
GROUP BY p.page_name
ORDER BY p.page_name
SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) FROM bank_sales_trading.main.shopping_cart_events WHERE page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13) GROUP BY event_type
